description: Catalog of current Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, and Alibaba (Qwen) models mapped to operational tiers (T1-T3), each row checked against the provider's own pages.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.strengths: Fastest current Claude model with near-frontier intelligence; extended thinking; 64K max output.
notes: Retirement is not sooner than 2026-10-15 (Anthropic's stated commitment); plan a replacement for T1 use.
The alias haiku did not resolve to Haiku when tested with Claude Code; use the full id.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5
models.strengths: Best combination of speed and intelligence; adaptive thinking; 128K max output.
notes: $2/$10 was introductory pricing and is now the standard price; the planned increase to $3/$15 will not occur.
Claude 4.7 and later use a tokenizer that yields about 30% more tokens for the same text than Sonnet 4.6 and earlier, so per-task cost differs from the per-token price.

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.strengths: Complex agentic coding and enterprise work; Anthropic's suggested starting model for most workloads; adaptive thinking; 128K max output.
notes: Claude 4.7 and later use a tokenizer that yields about 30% more tokens for the same text than Sonnet 4.6 and earlier, so per-task cost differs from the per-token price.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.strengths: Demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work; adaptive thinking always on; slower than Opus 5; 128K max output.
notes: Cache hits are priced at 0.025x the base input price on this model, against 0.1x on the others.
Claude 4.7 and later use a tokenizer that yields about 30% more tokens for the same text than Sonnet 4.6 and earlier, so per-task cost differs from the per-token price.

models.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
models.strengths: GPT-5.6 model optimized for cost-sensitive workloads; 128K max output.
notes: Regional processing (data residency) endpoints carry a 10% uplift for models released on or after 2026-03-05.

models.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
models.strengths: GPT-5.6 model that balances intelligence and cost; 128K max output.

models.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.strengths: Flagship model for complex professional work (alias gpt-5.6); 128K max output.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.strengths: OpenAI's most capable model, built for the hardest end-to-end work; 128K max output.

models.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
models.strengths: Low-latency, cost-effective multimodal model for high-throughput subagent tasks and document parsing; stable; 65,536 max output.
notes: The context-caching price read as $0.03 on one pass of the pricing page and as not available on another; it is left unrecorded.

models.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.strengths: Most intelligent Flash model, engineered for long-horizon software engineering, agents, and enterprise workflows; stable; 65,536 max output.
notes: These prices apply through 2026-12-31. From 2027-01-01 the page lists input $1.50, output $7.50, and context caching $0.15.

models.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro (Preview)
models.strengths: Refines the Gemini 3 Pro series with better thinking, token efficiency, and factual consistency for software engineering and agentic workflows; preview status; 65,536 max output.
notes: Prices shown are for prompts up to 200k tokens. Above 200k: input $4.00, output $18.00, context caching $0.40.
Preview status: identifiers and prices can change before general availability.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.strengths: 1M context and up to 384K output; supports non-thinking and thinking (default) modes.
notes: Peak rates are shown; off-peak rates are half. Peak hours are 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays.
The retired names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted and served by this model at the Flash price.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
models.strengths: Larger of the two V4 models (1.6T total, 49B active parameters); 1M context and up to 384K output; thinking mode on by default.
notes: Peak rates are shown; off-peak rates are half (same peak hours as deepseek-flash).
The tier is this catalog's judgment: DeepSeek's pages give no positioning statement for the model.

models.name: Qwen3.8 Flash
models.strengths: Fast multimodal Qwen model; thinking mode supported; 131,072 max output.
notes: Singapore/International pricing. A context-caching discount exists but its rate was not stated, so the cache price is unrecorded.

models.name: Qwen3.7 Plus
models.strengths: Cost-effective Plus model with agent-level intelligence for coding, tool use, and productivity workflows; thinking mode supported; 131,072 max output.
notes: Singapore/International pricing. Read once only: the $0.40 input price applies to 0-256K tokens, and the page also shows higher tiers and a limited-time 20% discount that were not resolved. Verify before budgeting.

models.name: Qwen3.8 Max
models.strengths: 2.4-trillion-parameter MoE flagship with strong coding and office-productivity results; thinking mode supported; 131,072 max output.
notes: Singapore/International pricing. A context-caching discount exists but its rate was not stated, so the cache price is unrecorded.

pairings.advantage: Independent vendors and harnesses, so no shared context, prompts, or blind spots. Both CLIs were checked against the installed versions.
The reverse of the first pairing; the reviewer runs read-only under --permission-mode plan.
Lowest-priced T3 reviewer in this catalog at peak rates. The pi DeepSeek preset ids are unchecked, so confirm the preset before relying on it.
